word: Title: Morning At The Language Class
answer: Mañana En La Clase De Idiomas

word: I use simple words to start the warm‑up.
answer: "Uso palabras sencillas para empezar el calentamiento."

word: You are going to utilize your notes today. [sing, inf]
We leave the door open for fresh air.
answer: "Abandonamos la puerta abierta para que entre aire."

word: They open their books to the first page.
answer: "Abren sus libros en la primera página."

word: I end the review with a short question.
answer: "Acabo la revisión con una pregunta corta."

word: You bring over your chair to join us. [sing, formal]
answer: "Acerca su silla para unirse a nosotros."

word: We accompany the new student to her seat.
answer: "Acompañamos a la estudiante nueva a su lugar."

word: They act out a short dialogue.
I am going to go to the board to write.
answer: "Voy a acudir al pizarrón para escribir."

word: You reach the correct answer quickly. [pl]
We analyze the sentence together.
They announce the next activity.
You apply the rule correctly. [sing, inf]
We provide examples for everyone.
They support each other during practice.
answer: "Apoyan a sus compañeros durante la práctica."

word: You are going to take advantage of the break. [sing, formal]
I point out the verb in the sentence.
We secure the papers with a clip.
They attend every class with enthusiasm.
You link the new word to an image. [pl]
answer: "Asocian la palabra nueva con una imagen."

word: I assume the group is ready to continue.
answer: "Asumo que el grupo está listo para continuar."

word: We add another example to the list.
They sing a short rhyme to remember it.
You are going to share your answer next. [sing, inf]
We declare the activity finished.
They highlight the most important rule.
I insist on practicing one more time.
